title: Speak to Nellie

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: You have the look of a person searching for something. Like a snifferbot on a trail...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have the look of a person searching for something. Like a snifferbot on a trail...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: That’s me! Did you read my post on the Kronickler Forum or The Nivalis Nocturne about the restructuring of electrical outlets during the Curzonan Dynasty?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s me! Did you read my post on the Kronickler Forum or The Nivalis Nocturne about the restructuring of electrical outlets during the Curzonan Dynasty?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Oh, do you fall into euphoric trances while looking at old route maps too? It's OK, it's a common problem...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, do you fall into euphoric trances while looking at old route maps too? It's OK, it's a common problem...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: You saw her too?! CORA this is so exciting… There’s only a handful of us who have ever physically encountered her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You saw her too?! CORA this is so exciting… There’s only a handful of us who have ever physically encountered her.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Ghost as in, "spirit of a dead person?" I don’t know. Maybe! She could be anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ghost as in, "spirit of a dead person?" I don’t know. Maybe! She could be anything.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Neither could I. So I did some digging. It took the best part of six weeks in the archives of the Programmer’s Museum.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Neither could I. So I did some digging. It took the best part of six weeks in the archives of the Programmer’s Museum.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: The Ghost, she’s speaking in CODE.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Ghost, she’s speaking in CODE.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: No! An ancient programming language called KorēChant. Only a few people remember that it exists.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No! An ancient programming language called KorēChant. Only a few people remember that it exists.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Of course! But I've never seen her again. I have a theory that she’s on some sort of loop, repeating the pattern of her own movements.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course! But I've never seen her again. I have a theory that she’s on some sort of loop, repeating the pattern of her own movements.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I think she must be. Either that or there’s an underground society still programming in KorēChant. Which… would be just as wonderful actually.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think she must be. Either that or there’s an underground society still programming in KorēChant. Which… would be just as wonderful actually.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: It should translate the ghost's code into something your Automata can parse. Here, take this copy. And if you see her again, come tell me, OK?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It should translate the ghost's code into something your Automata can parse. Here, take this copy. And if you see her again, come tell me, OK?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: The other historians think we're doing a spook hoax to get more subscriptions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The other historians think we're doing a spook hoax to get more subscriptions.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Holographic debris, a failed consciousness transfer… Wait. Did you SPEAK to her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Holographic debris, a failed consciousness transfer… Wait. Did you SPEAK to her?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Most of that was because I got lost between stacks and had to survive on rats and candy bars - but in the end I discovered something...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Most of that was because I got lost between stacks and had to survive on rats and candy bars - but in the end I discovered something...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Garbled noises you didn't understand?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Garbled noises you didn't understand?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: But I was able to smuggle a transcription codex from the museum just in case I ever saw her again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I was able to smuggle a transcription codex from the museum just in case I ever saw her again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm looking for a historian called Nellie…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm looking for a historian called Nellie…
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm looking for a historian called Nellie…
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm looking for a historian called Nellie…

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is kind of embarrassing...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is kind of embarrassing...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I read your post about a ghost in the sewers...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I read your post about a ghost in the sewers...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I read your post about a ghost in the sewers...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I read your post about a ghost in the sewers...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I think I saw a ghost in the sewers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I think I saw a ghost in the sewers.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I think I saw a ghost in the sewers.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I think I saw a ghost in the sewers.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think she’s really a ghost?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think she’s really a ghost?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You think she’s really a ghost?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think she’s really a ghost?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I couldn't understand her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I couldn't understand her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean like riddles...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean like riddles...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So she’s old?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So she’s old?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you go back to the Sewers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you go back to the Sewers?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did you go back to the Sewers?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did you go back to the Sewers?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does this codex do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does this codex do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I will, thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lucky me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lucky me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why did I see her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why did I see her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wouldn't call that speaking ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't call that speaking ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Six weeks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Six weeks?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not afraid of ghosts, are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not afraid of ghosts, are you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're not afraid of ghosts, are you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're not afraid of ghosts, are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Machine code?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Machine code?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Scary.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Scary.
